title: Flag Tower of Hanoi
visualBrief: Specific Flag Tower of Hanoi: three mapped stepped battered brick terraces, pale pierced parapets/corner posts and bounded supported access flights, tapered octagonal brick shaft with round recessed rosette openings, genuinely open octagonal observation crown/closed roof lip, pole and double-sided red flag/yellow star. Five existing shared brick/stucco/limestone/painted-metal/canvas graphs. No copied inscription, weathering/photo atlas, interior staircase, cafe, military equipment, whole museum or adjacent monument.

Native anchor105.839823532,21.032590491; global heading0 with internal east/south rotation from the first mapped lower-terrace edge. Octagonal shaft/crown phases follow their mapped outlines. Fine gate/stair/facade allocation remains picture-led with25degree/3m uncertainty; no directed surveyed entrance is asserted.
